verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents only sharing of individual codes through temporary, end-to-end encrypted links, and that sharing is limited to TOTP entries. That is a one-off, link-based sharing feature, not shared vaults or collections with per-member access control. No evidence shows shared vaults, team collections, member roles or permission management, so the link-sharing feature is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
